worldcombat.skill.tropkick.summary: Sinks its weight, steps in and drives a kick of southern heat upward into the target: the hit deals contact damage and shoves it back (or launches it into the air), and lowers its Attack by one stage; the impact point is left with a scorched ring. Drive mode kicks heavier, launch mode lifts the target.
worldcombat.skill.tropkick.use.0: Cut a target's physical output up close
worldcombat.skill.tropkick.use.1: Lift a target off the ground and force it to land again
worldcombat.skill.tropkick.use.2: Use the fastest kick to disarm a threat first
worldcombat.skill.tropkick.description.0: The kick deals about %1$s contact damage on impact.
worldcombat.skill.tropkick.description.1: Steps up to %1$s blocks toward the target (%2$s blocks per tick) with a %3$s-block collision radius; it stops and settles on contact, on being blocked, or once the distance is spent, and whiffs if it never touches a body.
worldcombat.skill.tropkick.description.2: A hit shoves the target about %1$s blocks and lowers its physical Attack by %2$s stage, so the physical damage it deals drops; launch form instead lifts it about %3$s blocks with only a little horizontal push.
worldcombat.skill.tropkick.launch.on: Launch form: the hit lifts the target upward and forces it to land again, with only a little horizontal push; costs x0.85 power and +4 cooldown ticks.
worldcombat.skill.tropkick.launch.off: Drive: power x1.12, a low flat kick that hits harder.
worldcombat.skill.tropkick.timing: Castable within %1$s blocks; after a %2$s wind-up it recovers for %3$s, spends %4$s PP, and goes on cooldown for %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.tropkick.growth.0: From level %1$s the kick rises to %2$s power.
worldcombat.skill.tropkick.growth.1: From level %1$s the kick rises again to %2$s power.
worldcombat.skill.tropkick.preference.la: On: the hit lifts the target upward and forces it to land again, with only a little horizontal push; costs x0.85 power and +4 cooldown ticks. Off (drive): power x1.12, a low flat kick that hits harder.
worldcombat.skill.tropkick.preference.ai: The companion only kicks once the target is within this distance; larger values kick earlier and miss more before the step lands.
On: a target with a lower health ratio ranks higher so the fastest kick goes for the kill. Off: ordinary melee ordering.
